title: Reproduction package: GOTM with sea-ice thermodynamics at station KG6 (GOTM, MPAS-ADC, Oceananigans LES, Icepack)
description: Model source code (GOTM v6 + STIM with an Icepack coupling, MPAS-Ocean with the ADC closure of Garanaik et al. 2024 with salt-conservation fixes, Oceananigans LES scripts), coupling code, experiment configurations, forcing and initial-condition files, satellite sea-ice data and analysis scripts needed to reproduce the results and figures of the manuscript 'GOTM with Sea-Ice Thermodynamics as a Foundation for Ocean-Ice Process Studies: Testing a Nonlocal Mass-Flux Closure, Large-Eddy Simulation and Mushy-Layer Sea Ice at a Subpolar Station'. No model output is included; all of it is regenerated by the run scripts.
